title: Worker queue record dispatch
summary: Copies a string into the selected worker buffer and appends its metadata and copied address to a selected record vector, unless disabled.
test_description: Compare original and recovered dispatch with empty and nonempty strings, different buffer and vector indices and offsets, and disabled dispatch with null input; check records, copied bytes, other fields, and FS head restoration.
known_limits: Vector allocation and growth are delegated to append_queue_record and are not recovered here; comparisons use spare capacity.
Indices, source termination, destination capacity, and nonoverlap are caller obligations in the original; invalid inputs are not tested.
The meaning of the record fields and disabled flag is unresolved.
